questions.stem: $A$ has position vector $\begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ 3 \end{pmatrix}$ and $B$ has position vector $\begin{pmatrix} 8 \\ 7 \end{pmatrix}$. What is the position vector of the midpoint $M$ of $AB$?
Points $P$ and $Q$ have position vectors $\begin{pmatrix} -1 \\ 6 \end{pmatrix}$ and $\begin{pmatrix} 3 \\ -2 \end{pmatrix}$. What is the distance $PQ$?
questions.explanation: $\overrightarrow{PQ} = \begin{pmatrix} 3-(-1) \\ -2-6 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 4 \\ -8 \end{pmatrix}$. The distance is $|\overrightarrow{PQ}| = \sqrt{4^2 + (-8)^2} = \sqrt{16 + 64} = \sqrt{80}$. Note that $\sqrt{80} = 4\sqrt{5}$, so both A and B are equivalent, but the exact surd form is $\sqrt{80}$.
